description: This file defines middleware for Express.js to enforce tenant-aware access control on database interactions, including functions to filter objects, queries, and aggregations based on tenant ID, as well as attaching tenant info to requests.

methods.name: isMongooseQuery
methods.description: Checks if an object is a Mongoose query by verifying presence of 'where' or 'find' methods.

methods.name: filterObject
methods.description: Ensures an object has a 'tenant_id' property set to the given tenantId.

methods.name: filterQuery
methods.description: Adds a tenant_id filter to a Mongoose query if not already present.

methods.name: applyToAggregation
methods.description: Prepends a $match stage with tenant_id to an aggregation pipeline if not already present.

methods.name: stampCreate
methods.description: Sets or enforces the tenant_id on a document before creation.

methods.name: tenantScopeEnforcer
methods.description: Middleware function that attaches tenant-aware helper methods and tenant ID to the request object.
